exposure.needed: how JMX is enabled in the environment (the change text names no CR field, Helm value or config key that carries it)

consequence.statement: Environments with JMX enabled will use JVM network defaults instead of the previous implicit IPv4 preference; per the changelog this makes the cluster boot up correctly in IPv6-only environments where the IPv4 preference would break it.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the implicit IPv4 preference that was applied when JMX was enabled; JMX now uses JVM defaults, so clusters boot correctly in IPv6-only environments where the IPv4 preference would break startup.
